evidence.quote:
requires a signed release
manifest before it ships

observations.why: The directive frames a mandatory security gate as the appealed-to good — stability and safety before deployment.

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Past security failures are cited as the justification for a protective gate, appealing to both stability (conservation) and quality-of-craft accountability (competence).
The gate summary foregrounds a security requirement as the governing value of the deployment process.
Extending the security gate across environments reinforces conservation — the rule protects stability everywhere.
Assigning ownership of the gate names a responsible party for the security requirement, reinforcing the conservation value of accountable stability.
